name: home-inventory-pwa
description: Kućni inventar PWA — tehnički pilot v0.0.1 (faza P0: infrastruktura)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-home-inventory-rules "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:no-actions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:sdk
scripts.build:prod: npm run guard:env && npm run build && npm run guard:dist
scripts.deploy:rules: npm run guard:rules && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --project home-inventory-pwa-218be
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --only hosting --project home-inventory-pwa-218be
scripts.test:sdk: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-home-inventory-sdk "vitest run --config vitest.sdk.config.ts"
